  --pill-min-w: 130px;

  display:inline-flex !important;
  border-radius:9999px !important;
  overflow:hidden;
}

  display:flex !important;
  align-items:center !important;
  justify-content:center !important;
  min-width:var(--pill-min-w) !important;  /* uniform width */
  height:var(--pill-h) !important;
  padding:0 12px !important;               /* allows longer labels to grow */

#filters-bar .jet-color-image-list__label{
  line-height:1 !important; 
  margin:0 !important;

  background-image:var(--pill-gradient) !important;
  color:#fff !important;
  font-weight:700 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(78,94,214,.9) inset !important;
